notes.title: Demo v0.7
notes.content:
New features

DPS table in the stats panel
A new table in the stats panel shows the damage dealt per attack since the last level up

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/b7b3eeb4ff6c99dadff46b268d3760e76a8a4f36.png"]
Collection screen
A new screen on the main menu shows you which spells, totems, and scrolls you've discovered and displays their effects and stats.


5 new elemental melee spells
There are 5 new spells that do high damage to nearby enemies. Each has its own elemental type and attack patterns to learn.


New portal skip rewards and treasure drops
New rewards can be earned from skipping level-up portals or opening treasure chests

Choose 1 free rare totem

Choose 1 free epic totem

Increase attack size


Quality of life featuresNew setting to disable projectiles
When things are getting really crazy late in a run the attack visuals can be overwhelming and make it hard to see what's going on. You can now disable all attack effects in the settings menu so that you can get a better view of what's happening.


New recipe book filter for current production
The recipe book can now be filtered to only show recipes you're currently producing

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/378c7acab73e9d5660e81ac78668d860f2035ed5.png"]


Bug fixes/Performance
Fix: Window positioning/sizing on multi-monitor setups

Fix: Various totem behavior bugs

Fix: When placing multiple pairs of tunnel belts, you will automatically switch between input and output without having to manually re-select input.

Performance: Enemy physics have been fully reworked to improve performance while also increasing the total number of enemies that can be on the screen


Balancing/Other changes
Elite spawns in higher Arcana Levels have been reworked to be more randomized and continuous making harder difficulties a little more chaotic and challenging

Difficulty scaling has been tweaked on higher difficulties to ramp up the challenge more over time

Multiple totems have been reworked to be more useful

Hex areas are now all increased in size

Visual effects have been toned down a bit to reduce overly bright visuals

notes.title: Patch v0.63
notes.content:
New music!
Thanks to Alfie Morris for composing the new soundtrack!


Performance improvements

 Improved initial launch load times
 Reduced in-game stuttering due to shader compilation
 Improved performance when a lot of enemies are on screen at once


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that counterintuitively caused frame rate to drop significantly when damage numbers were disabled in settings
 Fixed multiple save/resume bugs causing certain totem buffs to be lost/reset or incorrectly calculated
 Fixed save/resume bugs causing scroll usage order to be lost


Other

 When the "Reduce Effects" settings option is enabled it will now remove the status effect particles (fire, poison, etc.) which reduces visual noise and also can improve performance on lower end systems
 Window size and position are now restored when restarting the game in windowed mode
 Fixed tooltips when hovering from a factory part/totem to a blocked factory space

notes.title: Demo v0.6
notes.content:
New features

Hexes and Charms

Hexes are a new mechanic that affect your factory every 6 levels. A region of the factory grid will have certain parts disabled for the duration of the level. You'll be warned about what region and what factory part will be disabled 2 levels in advance so you have time to prepare!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/f8e3b2a0cf1e71ae2054931168ccd45a7cbd08a3.png

Once you've made it past the Hex level, you'll earn a choice between 1 of 2 Charms, the other new mechanic. Charms augment sinks placed within a region of the factory giving spells new properties or changing their elemental type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/0b98edbbe6a4f8f39571537a5d4c93e1a73e9165.png

Reworked shop

The shop has been changed from 3 slots to 5 slots, and the base reroll price has been reduced but now doubles instead of increasing by 1. This change gives you more (and cheaper!) options in the early game, and also prevents reroll-spam in the late game. It also ensures that you're consistently getting factory parts instead of losing one of three shop slots from a totem/scroll.

Treasure chests

Treasure chests now spawn during combat which can be opened by standing near them and defending your position for a bit. These chests drop random rewards like sinks or money.

[expand]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/8cd9d855580db337521b681ad8a40a930054ae31.png
[/expand]

Splitter filters

Splitters can now have resource or recipe filters applied to them so they will always move certain resources in the specified direction.

[expand]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/b68e55bc11b38c46844daac45e2bd185099f466f.png
[/expand]
New and re-balanced scrolls

Scrolls now have new art, roll more often, and two new scrolls have been added. The big addition here is a new scroll that allows you to move totems around the factory.

Other new things


 There is now a daily challenge mode that can be started from the character select
 New totems to discover
 New spells


Quality of life improvements

Hotkeys

There are now hotkeys for selecting factory parts that can be viewed in the new controls menu both from the main menu and while in game.

Settings during a run + new settings

You can now adjust settings like volume/effects/etc while in a run without having to quit back to the main menu. There are also now settings to reduce spell opacity and remove damage numbers to make things a little easier to see when things get really crazy.

Recipe sorting options

You can now change the recipe book to be sorted by element or assembler type.

Various visual tweaks


 All text has been adjusted to make it easier to read
 Tooltip text has been cleaned up and resized
 Improved misc effects and graphics


Balancing & bug fixes


 Balance: Recycling has been further reduced to just a flat $2 instead of doubling over the course of the run
 Balance: Various totem rarities, prices, and effects have been adjusted
 Balance: Scroll prices and drop rates have been buffed
 Balance: Various spell buffs/nerfs
 Fix: Certain totems didn't load their game state correctly when resuming a run
 Performance: Factory and combat optimizations

notes.title: Demo v0.5
notes.content:
New features

Unlockables

This version includes 2 new playable character classes to unlock and 4 new difficulty levels. The higher difficulty levels also give a sneak peek of some new enemy types including ranged enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/ea6ffbfe1b68221d9f586493bf86493a04bcae26.png

Quit and resume run

By popular demand, you can now quit mid-run and resume where you left off but will be reset to the last time you leveled up. To support this change the save system had to be reworked so your save file will be reset again. Hopefully this is the last time!

Scrolls

Scrolls are a new mechanic that function as consumables. A few examples of scroll effects:

 Increase damage by 50% for the next 20 seconds of combat
 Reduce enemy movement speed by 50% for the next 20 seconds of combat
 Reset shop reroll price to $0
 and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/9f333a7398d9679333e6a00a7f3d860813688201.png

Scrolls can be used at any time, including during combat! Once used they are removed from the factory grid allowing that space to be used for crafting.

Other

 New totems!
 If you can make it to near the end of a run there is a new type of enemy to encounter 👀


Quality of life features

Tooltip overhaul

All tooltips have been completely reworked to improve clarity.

Totem tooltips now include their relevant effects:
[expand]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/ca55babbd86ab7b7a9dde1c83d9888ff300b4e5a.png
[/expand]

Assembler tooltips now show their status including, recipe craft time adjusted by Power Crystals, and inventory status:
[expand]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/9808943dc607a61d174ec6730b3288b1e21d8535.png
[/expand]

DPS meter

A new DPS meter can be opened by clicking the stats button in the top left of the factory grid allowing you to optimize your build by seeing the changes in your damage over time or just to watch your big numbers get bigger.

[expand]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/d9465acf6326b95a152f2ea93718169e8c3a5622.png
[/expand]

Balancing & Bug fixes

 Balance: tweaks to rarity levels and totem bonuses
 Balance: improved knockback
 Balance: minor attack damage adjustments
 Balance: buffs now apply to elemental damage over time
 Fix: leveling up with 0hp and dying immediately after
 Fix: leveling up as the portal disappears
 Fix: the delay when the factory grid is filled up with Rabbit/Locust totems
 Fix: incorrect totem stat buff calculations
 Fix: buying a totem when you don't have space for it
 Factory and combat performance improvements

notes.title: Demo v0.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks for all the feedback/interest in the game so far! This is an update to some core game mechanics + a few miscellaneous quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

Changes to core mechanics

Getting rid of Recycle Points
The problem:
Originally Recycle Points were intended as a way to do two things:
[olist]
 Keep the pacing of the game up by preventing players from spending too much time in their factory refactoring everything
 Reinforce the roguelike nature of the game of progressively locking you into a build that becomes harder and harder to pivot out of.
[/olist]

Response to this was mixed. Some players were confused by it and others actually spent more time in their factory because they felt like they needed to think too far ahead.

The change:
Recycle Points are now gone, but to keep with the original spirit of them recycling is still not free. Recycling now starts at $2 per part placed in a previous factory session and doubles in price every 10 levels.

Recycle Points may make a reappearance in the future as a challenge mode.

Portal skips
A new game mechanic is Portal Skips. Every 5th portal that spawns will give you the option to skip entering the portal to earn some reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/02672608534773a6219207b048f3dae0fa5817ef.png

A few Portal Skip Reward examples:

 Free Sink
 +100% Fire damage
 +25% Movement speed
 and more!


This gives players another way to earn passive buffs or bypass some of the shop RNG elements while also letting you spend more time in combat to see how well your build is performing

New features

There are a few new totems to discover!

Quality of life changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215396/f214f12a2bbb12a0fb115610596f621f3b811112.png


 Tunnel belts now highlight their path and display max length when placing or hovering
 Assemblers now display the actual crafting time of the current recipe when hovered over
 Scroll-wheel to rotate parts
 Automatically switches to tunnel belt output after placing a tunnel belt input since they are usually placed in pairs.


Bugfixes

 Fixed recipe book becoming inactive after recycling 
 Fixed cursor lag on the factory grid causing misplacing parts sometimes


Future

Metaprogression is still being worked on and we hope to have a sneak peak of that + more recipes and totems for an upcoming Steam NextFest so stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo v0.3
notes.content:
We've been working on a lot of the metaprogression content for the full release, but in the meantime here is a much needed quality of life and balancing patch to hopefully smooth out some of the rougher edges based off of player feedback.

Due to some of the new recipe changes + metaprogression work going on behind the scenes, your save file will likely be incompatible and reset. Sorry about that!

New features

 6 new totems

Quality of life changes

 More intuitive drag-to-place belts
 Allow placing parts on top of a belt segment that can be automatically recycled
 Reworked recipe book to allow navigating to ingredients/products
 Right click to erase
 Ctrl + Right click to recycle
 Q to deselect/eyedropper tool
 Clicking an assembler brings you to the current recipe
 Clicking a source node brings you to recipes that can be crafted with it
 Clicking a recipe's ingredient in the recipe book brings you to its entry
 Combat controls more prominently displayed
 Dash refresh icon
 CRT filter toggle in settings
 Improved initial load times

Balancing

 Extended coin drop lifetime
 Reworked Rabbit totem to be a flat belt speed upgrade that scales
 Reworked all potion recipes to be simpler to produce
 Misc. damage/pierce/status effect buffs/nerfs based off of player feedback
 Changed Scallop totem to 25% source node speed increase, made it uncommon so it shows up in the shop less because it's more situational than the other flat speed increases

Bug fixes

 Fixed Monkey totem causing loss of inventory source nodes
 Fixed Parrot totem's copy condition which previously allowed it to re-copy the same spell
 Fixed some spells not reporting damage correctly in the stats screen
